takeaways: Ferguson, the plumbing and HVAC distributor, made $3.43 adjusted vs $3.29 expected, on $9.0 billion of sales, up 9.5% (Seeking Alpha, StockTitan).
It raised full-year 2026 sales growth guidance to about 7% from mid-single-digit growth. Its fiscal quarter ended Sept 30, labeled Q3 in the release.
The stock slid about 3% from Nov 3 to Friday's close ahead of the report, so expectations had cooled.
verdict: Ferguson sells pipes, boilers and the stuff behind your wall, and it beat and raised. Boring and profitable, which in this market is the new exotic. Max says the toilet economy is fine.
